title: DisSparse: Pipelined Top-$p$ Sparse Attention for Long-Context LLM Serving
abstract: arXiv:2611.28522v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-context LLM inference is bottlenecked by the memory demands of the key-value (KV) cache, whose size scales linearly with context length. Dynamic sparse attention reduces this bottleneck by fetching and attending only to a critical subset of tokens. The dominant primitive in dynamic sparse attention research and deployment is fixed-budget top-$k$ selection, which is favored because its deterministic block count aligns with the static memory allocation that systems like vLLM rely on. Top-$k$ uses a fixed budget regardless of how attention mass is distributed across heads, layers, and decode steps, leading to either wasted bandwidth on heads with peaky attention or dropped context on heads with diffuse attention. Top-$p$ (nucleus) selection adapts naturally to this variation but has seen limited adoption in production serving systems due to two system-level challenges: variable block counts that break deterministic block allocation a

translated_title: DisSparse：面向长上下文LLM服务的流水线化Top-$p$稀疏注意力
translated_abstract: 长上下文LLM推理的瓶颈在于键值缓存（KV cache）的内存需求，其大小随上下文长度线性增长。动态稀疏注意力通过仅获取并关注关键的token子集来缓解这一瓶颈。动态稀疏注意力研究与部署中的主流原语是固定预算的top-$k$选择，其受青睐的原因在于其确定性的块数量与vLLM等系统所依赖的静态内存分配机制相契合。然而，无论注意力质量在各头、各层和各解码步骤中如何分布，top-$k$都使用固定预算，这导致对于注意力高度集中的头会浪费带宽，而对于注意力分散的头则会丢失上下文。Top-$p$（核采样）选择能够自然地适应这种变化，但由于两个系统级挑战——可变的块数量破坏了确定性块分配机制等，其在生产服务系统中的采用仍然有限。
tldr: 提出DisSparse，一种流水线化的Top-$p$稀疏注意力方法，能够根据注意力在不同头、层和解码步骤中的分布变化动态调整token预算，从而克服固定预算top-$k$方法浪费带宽或丢失上下文的问题，优化长上下文LLM推理服务。
en_tdlr: DisSparse introduces a pipelined top-$p$ sparse attention mechanism that dynamically adapts token budgets to variations in attention distribution across heads, layers, and decode steps, addressing the limitations of fixed-budget top-$k$ selection for long-context LLM serving.
